Vyom ReportsROADMAP

Periodic safety reports, drafted from your data.

Line listings, cumulative tables and literature summaries assembled for PSURs, PBRERs, DSURs and US periodic reports.

Talk to us about thisPRICING·Per report
THE PROBLEM

PSURs, PBRERs, DSURs and US periodic reports take weeks of assembly before experts can start writing.

CAPABILITIES

What it does.

  • Line listings and cumulative tables
  • Literature and signal summaries
  • Section drafts citing source data
  • Author and physician review
  • Version history
HOW IT WORKS

Five steps, every time.

  1. 01Pull the data

    Line listings and cumulative tables are assembled from your cases for the reporting period.

  2. 02Summarise

    Literature and signal activity for the period is summarised alongside them.

  3. 03Draft sections

    Section drafts are written citing the source data, so every statement can be traced back.

  4. 04Review

    Authors and physicians review and rewrite, with the underlying data one click away.

  5. 05Version

    Every change is kept in version history, so the path from first draft to final report is visible.
